interpretation_limit: Independent audit of this fixed graph/workload on the measured host only; RUSAGE_SELF is process-wide including threads, RUSAGE_CHILDREN covers reaped children, and the 12 pairs do not establish sustained, portable, whole-application, energy, or capacity behavior. AB/BA grouping is descriptive, not causal.

post_run_host_observation.interpretation: This is a post-run process snapshot, not an in-timer profile. It indicates other desktop Codex and Chromium activity on the shared host; elapsed lifetime may overlap some late pairs, but exact overlap and attributable CPU cannot be inferred. No pairs were excluded or retried.
post_run_host_observation.observation: Other desktop Codex processes and a Chromium headless process were active on shared host. This is a single-host run under background activity; no pairs were excluded or retried. Post-run ps CPU is not an in-timer profile; elapsed time can indicate process lifetime overlap only.
post_run_host_observation.phase: after completed diagnostic, during combined product build
